name: agent-completion-chime
description: Make a sound when AI agents finish. Per-agent chime on Stop / SubagentStop, all-complete chime when the active-agent set drains. Configurable via 9 MCP tools (chime_status, chime_list_sounds, chime_set_per_agent_sound, chime_set_all_complete_sound, chime_set_volume, chime_enable, chime_disable, chime_test, chime_reset_active). macOS only.
